description: Writes the flow changes your person agreed to, after ai_edit_flow proposed them. Send the changes exactly as the proposal returned them (each with flowId, the patch, and a label), plus the proposal's command and summary. Every patch is re-checked against the flow as it is right now: a field the AI edit may not touch, or a step that has since moved, is dropped rather than mis-applied. Before writing, each flow's prior state is saved to Recent changes, so the whole batch can be undone with the editor's own revert (the 5-second toast or ⋯ → Recent changes). Show your person the exact changes before you apply. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat does not write twice.

fields.description: For update_step / update_flow: only the fields that change.

index.description: For add_step: where the new step goes (0-based; default the end).

step.description: For add_step: the new step, with a title (and channel/message_template for a text or email step).

stepIndex.description: For update_step / remove_step: the 0-based step to change.

command.description: The instruction that produced the proposal, shown on the undo row.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

summary.description: The proposal's one-sentence summary, shown on the undo row.

name: apply_flow_ai_edit
title: Apply chosen flow changes (revertable)
